title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: Merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted list.

data.text: Merge two sorted linked lists and return the merged list.

data.title: O(n+m) O(1)
O(n+m) O(n+m)

data.caption: Iterative merge compares the heads of both lists and advances the smaller one, building the result through a dummy tail.
data.definition:
graph TB
    A[a=1->3->5] --> C{1 <= 2?}
    B[b=2->4->6] --> C
    C -->|Yes| D[tail=1]
    D --> E[a=3->5 b=2->4->6]
    E --> F{3 <= 2?}
    F -->|No| G[tail=2]
    G --> H[a=3->5 b=4->6]
    style D fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32
    style G fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32
